scenes.headline: How a small language model writes speech
scenes.sub: The engine inside five Ming-3.0 speech models
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Umbel! Ant Ling released five speech models, and one small engine does the talking. Here's how it writes sound.

scenes.text: A language model writes continuous audio frames, 12.5 a second, and every voice control is just text in its prompt.
scenes.say: A language model writes continuous audio frames, twelve and a half a second. And every voice control is just text in its prompt.

steps.say: The words and the controls go into a small language model as ordinary text.
A small diffusion transformer turns its hidden state into one audio frame, in ten steps from noise.
That frame is sixty-four numbers, eighty milliseconds of sound. It goes back in, and the loop repeats.
When a stop head says done, a decoder turns all the frames into a waveform in one pass.

left.title: The usual way
items: a codec turns audio into codes
the model picks codes from a vocabulary
left.say: The usual way turns audio into discrete codes and has the model pick from a vocabulary.

right.title: Ming-3.0-tts
items: a VAE turns audio into frames
a flow head draws each frame
right.say: Ming skips the vocabulary. A flow head draws each continuous frame directly.

steps.say: On the left, text tokens, controls and an optional speaker embedding.
Above the model, the DiT patch head and the decoder, chunk by chunk.

scenes.title: Same voice, bigger ears
scenes.say: The audio models are built around that engine.

items.say: A Whisper-shaped encoder hears the input.
A sparse mixture of experts reads it and writes text.
And the talker that speaks the answer is the same small model, byte for byte.

scenes.label: parameters in the checkpoint called 0.5B, counted from its header
scenes.say: The name counts the backbone. The whole checkpoint holds about one and a half billion.

scenes.title: Slower than real time, on two CPU threads
scenes.say: On a busy four-core machine it ran five to ten times slower than real time, and Whisper heard every English word.

scenes.text: One small loop of continuous frames, with controls written as text, is the voice of the whole release.
scenes.say: One small loop of continuous frames, with controls written as text, is the voice of the whole release.

recap: A language model writes audio frames
Controls and tags are only text
The same engine speaks for three models
scenes.say: Frames, not codes. Controls as text. One engine, speaking for three models.
